messages:
dana-finance: Noticed a mismatch on Azure Marketplace invoice AZ-2024-11-07 — reseller fee line missing for Channel Partner CP-88. Total looks ~-$9.2k lower than expected. Anyone else seeing this?#
kevin-partner-ops: Which AZ invoice number? I can pull the order mapping. Sometimes Marketplace separates partner fees into a separate settlement that arrives later.
ndashley-ops: Invoice AZ-2024-11-07 (attached link in billing UI). The order id is az-ord-5512. Our Expected revenue file shows partner surcharge of $9,175 for CP-88 but invoice line is absent.
azure-marketplace-bot: Automated: Settlement az-settle-20241103 processed 2024-11-07 UTC. Refer to document: https://portal.azure.com/marketplace/settlements/az-settle-20241103 (requires login).
kevin-partner-ops: I checked the partner ledger: CP-88 (BlueRidge Resellers) has a delayed settlement flag set for Europe region. That flag can cause separate payout entries.
tom-sales: BlueRidge pinged us this morning asking why their commission didn't show. They provided a payout stub that references our az-ord-5512 but not the invoice.
lina-cust-billing: Customer invoices are unaffected, correct?
dashley-ops: Yes customer charges were processed via our billing engine last week. This is an issue on the Azure settlement side — looks like a channel commission hold rather than missing customer usage.
dana-finance: For bookkeeping we need to know if this should be booked as a liability to partners or as an offset to cost of revenue. If it's a hold that will be paid later, we should accrue partner payable (2100) and not adjust revenue.
kevin-partner-ops: I'll reach out to BlueRidge and the Azure partner manager to confirm if this is a hold vs. reclassified settlement. If it's a hold, request payout ETA.
azure-marketplace-bot: Note: Some settlements for EU customers require VAT validation before release. If partner VAT not validated, Azure places a hold.
dana-finance: Action: (1) kevin to confirm hold reason and ETA with partner & Azure PM; (2) ashley to draft accrual JE for $9,175 to Partner Payables pending confirmation; (3) lina to annotate closed month report with footnote. I'll tentatively book accrual in Nov close but will finalize after partner confirmation.
kevin-partner-ops: Pinged BlueRidge rep and Azure PM (cc'ed). Will paste their replies here when they respond.
kevin-partner-ops: BlueRidge reply: "We're showing VAT docs in our portal but Azure flagged mismatch. We requested manual review. Expect release within 7-10 business days."
dana-finance: OK marking as partner hold. Ashley, leave accrual as provisional. I'll approve the JE once partner confirms in writing.
nashley-ops: Draft JE ready: DR Partner Commission Expense 6005 $9,175, CR Accrued Partner Payables 2100 $9,175. Memo: Azure settlement hold for CP-88 (az-ord-5512).
kevin-partner-ops: Azure PM replied: "Confirmed hold due to VAT validation discrepancy. Manual release requested. We'll update settlement status by 2024-11-17."
dana-finance: Thanks. We'll keep as accrual for Nov close and update when settlement posts. Adding to next week's close checklist. :white_check_mark:
lin a-cust-billing: Noting for customer communications: none needed unless partner asks for us to notify customers.
kevin-partner-ops: I'll follow up next Wed if no update.
